newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net Upland sales of 64,800 running bales (RB) were 31 percent below the previous week and 21 percent less than the 4-week average.

Major increases for China (25,400 RB), Brazil (17,800 RB), Mexico (10,100 RB), and Turkey (9,900 RB) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (25,600 RB, including 24,500 RB in 1997/98 sales erroneously summarized in the current marketing year). Sales of 34,800 RB for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily the noted correction of 24,500 RB for unknown destinations.

Exports of 146,300 RB were 9 percent below the previous week and 4 percent below the 4-week average. Asian destinations accounted for 66 percent of the week's shipments; Western Hemisphere, 26 percent; and West European, 8 percent.
